module: Flowgraph node "Race End Transform" (category repeat_instant, tag scenario). Gives the transform of the end pathnode of a pathData, useful for custom triggers. The end node is path.endNode; for a closed path without a valid endNode, it is startNode. Outputs: endExists / endDoesNotExist (flow), existing (bool), pos (vec3), dirVec (pathnode normal or {0,0,1}) and radius. Computed only once (as long as self.path is nil).
notes: If endNode is -1, a warning is logged: the end must be explicitly marked in the Race Editor.
endExists/endDoesNotExist are reset to false every frame; only endExists becomes true, and only during the initial computation: endDoesNotExist never becomes true in this code.

work.desc: Finds the end pathnode and writes existing, pos, dirVec, radius and the flows endExists/endDoesNotExist.
